steps.name: make-sloped-with-window
steps.eval: (() => { const st=window.__store.getState(); const fp=st.floorPlan; const len=(w)=>Math.hypot(w.end[0]-w.start[0],w.end[1]-w.start[1]); const wall=fp.walls.filter(w=>w.thickness==='external').sort((a,b)=>len(b)-len(a))[0]||fp.walls[0]; const L=len(wall); window.__store.getState().updateWall(wall.id,{topHeight:1.8, topHeightEnd:3.0}); const id=window.__store.getState().addOpening({kind:'window', wallId:wall.id, offset:Math.max(0.2,L/2-0.6), width:1.2, sill:0.6, head:1.8}); return JSON.stringify({wall:wall.id, len:L, opening:id}); })()
